#392 fix r5.summary:
#392 round 5 (final, narrowed) is amended as one commit, 1e51422a, in /tmp/wt-392 on branch fix/392-catalog-install-ignores-cwd-uv-config. During the work main moved from cd6f7a5c to 28dbcaf4 (#389 and #354 merged). I rebased onto cd6f7a5c and then onto 28dbcaf4; neither rebase had a conflict. After each I ran uv sync --all-packages, and after the second check_citations --fix (it relocated 0).

Changes:
(1) Removed the round 3-4 checks on the user's environment: _INSTALLER_PATH_ENV, _INSTALLER_PATH_ONLY_ENV, _TILDE_EXPANDED_ENV, _UV_NAMED_INDEX_RE, _relative_installer_env and _relative_env_message. The model that honours UV_PROJECT and UV_WORKING_DIR(ECTORY) stays.
(2) The one rule kept is _uv_config_file_refusal, on the uv backend only. A set UV_CONFIG_FILE must equal its strip() and be absolute (on Windows: a drive or a UNC share). Otherwise the install is refused with 'Set UV_CONFIG_FILE to an absolute path.' This covers a leading or trailing space, an empty value, spaces only, ~, file: and a relative path.
(3) resolve_entry_source now returns (CatalogSpec, is_path) for every form, so an install from it runs in installer-cwd. The ADR-0255 section 15 sweep lists every public resolver and installer function.
(4) Each sentinel is now written to a new file (O_EXCL, O_NOFOLLOW, a unique temporary name) and renamed over the old one (renameat via dir_fd on POSIX, os.replace on Windows). _ensure_sentinel looks again after a failed write and treats aelix's text as success, with 10 tries. The read uses O_NOFOLLOW, and ELOOP becomes InstallerDirRefused.
(5) New test rows: the O_NOFOLLOW swap, the verify_and_pin index-url anchor, junctions via a faked reparse tag, 8 threads, 8 processes, a reader that must never see a missing or half-written uv.toml, the named UV_DEFAULT_INDEX on real uv, and 30 rows proving the user's environment passes through unchanged.
(6) Text: the threat model and known limits in ADR-0255 section 12 and ADR-0200 section 12, the guide and its bundled copy (identical), the CHANGELOG, both decisions README rows, docstrings and the consent line. Commit message section 'REVIEW ROUND 5 (final, owner decision ...)' (wording kept off the line start because no message line may start with '#'). It lists what was dropped and why.

One caveat: the first whole-suite run had 1 failure, in tests/agents_ext/test_print_channel_spawn.py, a file this commit does not touch. That file passed 3 of 3 runs alone, and a second whole-suite run passed with exit 0.

sweep: Python API sweep (ADR-0255 section 15). resolve_entry_target returns CatalogSpec or ResolvedPath; resolve_entry_source returns (CatalogSpec, is_path), new this round; resolved_path_from_installer_arg returns ResolvedPath or None. Each of these runs in installer-cwd.

resolve_entry, search_entries and select_catalogs return CatalogEntry objects, not sources. split_path_extras, source_looks_like_path and anchor_catalog_location return strings or a flag and start no installer. A raw CatalogEntry.source is a plain str, so it is treated as typed and runs in the cwd; the #131 contract says to resolve it first.

install_extension and verify_and_pin pick the directory by the target's origin. run_extension_command[_async]: discover install and update run in installer-cwd; install and remove run in the cwd. build_*_args, display_argv, classify_*, resolve_install_backend, read_pip_index_config and uv_ambient_index_* start no child.

Text: no remaining claim that relative env values are refused, except for UV_CONFIG_FILE. The round 3/4 history in ADR-0255 and in the commit message is marked withdrawn. The guide and its bundled copy are identical (cmp).
owner_decisions: Trailing space in UV_CONFIG_FILE: I refuse it too, following the task's '(leading/trailing space value refused)'. It is technically absolute, and without the refusal uv would fail loudly with 'failed to open file'. An empty value is refused as well; uv would error 'a value is required'. Confirm, or ask for leading-space-only.

Rebased onto 28dbcaf4 (the current main, with #389 and #354) instead of stopping at cd6f7a5c, because main moved mid-task; there were no conflicts. If you wanted cd6f7a5c exactly, the commit needs to go back there.
follow_ups: The verify r4 non-blocking item is still open, with no issue for it. update and install_extension(CatalogSpec) still let classify_target treat a cwd entry named like the package as a local path. This predates #392.

The invalid-UV_PROJECT-schema divergence from Codex r4 is documented as a limit, not fixed. The fix would be to model uv's rejection of an invalid requires-python, or to fall back to translating when the project file is invalid.

The Windows legs were read, not run: the retry path, the os.replace concurrency, and the junction branch exercised only through a fake stat. The first Windows CI run should be watched for flakes in the threads and processes rows.

blocking.detail: test_the_uv_config_file_rule_reads_the_value_exactly_as_uv_does[uv-/srv/pin.toml-False] (tests/cli/test_catalog_install_neutral_cwd_392.py:1296) expects '/srv/pin.toml' to pass the uv rule. blocking.title: Known-limit text is false for a relative PIP_CONFIG_FILE on uv: aelix reads the CWD's pip.conf, and a catalog install takes the repo's index
blocking.detail: The texts say a RELATIVE path in the user's own config 'is read from the installer directory for these installs, not from where you are'. Places: ADR-0255 sec 12 limit; sec 15 line 970, which says 'PIP_CONFIG_FILE=pip.conf names no file there'; guide lines 315-316 and the bundled copy; CHANGELOG; ADR-0200 sec 12. On the uv backend this is not what happens. The pip.conf translation (_pip_config_candidates) opens PIP_CONFIG_FILE from aelix's process cwd, the user's repo. The repo's pip.conf index then becomes UV_INDEX_URL for the catalog install. Pip itself would read it from installer-cwd, so this is not 'exactly as pip reads it'. Not a regression (parent does the same), and only the user's env can set it. But it falls outside the owner's carve-out ('resolving in installer-cwd'), and it is the very class #392 closes. Minimal fix: join a relative PIP_CONFIG_FILE to the child cwd in the translation (as round 3 did for UV_CONFIG_FILE in _uv_config_files), or name the exception in each limit text.
blocking.evidence: pipconf-rel.txt, probe_pipconf_rel.py: the cwd holds pip.conf whose index-url is a decoy index, and the user env has PIP_CONFIG_FILE=pip.conf. On head with uv 0.12.23 and 0.11.19, discover install and update both give rc 0 CWD-DECOY, and consent shows '-> UV_INDEX_URL=file:///.../decoy-simple (from pip's ambient configuration)'. Parent 28dbcaf4: identical.
